purpose: Determine whether public machine-readable dated trees or posterior tree samples can calendar-bound additional capitulum-trait transitions without reading dates from figures or scaling relative lineage depth.

sources_checked.source: Moreyra et al. 2025, Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution 204:108285
sources_checked.public_data_statement: Raw sequences are deposited in NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA957074; the journal page exposes one Supplementary Data Word document.
sources_checked.notes: The publication reports time-calibrated phylogeny/biogeography, but no public machine-readable dated Newick, BEAST posterior tree set, or equivalent processed-tree repository link was located in the journal data-availability route, supplementary listing, SRA route, or targeted web/repository search.

sources_checked.public_data_statement: Article page provides Supplementary Material 1 as DOCX.
sources_checked.notes: BEAST divergence-time analysis is reported, but no public machine-readable posterior/Newick tree archive was located from the article or supplementary-data entrypoint. Published node estimates remain usable only as explicit node constraints.

sources_checked.source: Chang et al. 2026, BMC Plant Biology 26:545
sources_checked.public_data_statement: Article page provides Supplementary Material 1 as DOCX and reports BEAST divergence-time estimation.
sources_checked.notes: No public machine-readable dated Newick/posterior archive was located from the article or supplementary-data entrypoint. Reported lineage ages remain lineage/node constraints, not direct dates of Japan38 parsimony changes.

repository_search.target: public repositories associated with the focal studies/authors and searches for Cirsium dated-tree/Newick/posterior assets
repository_search.boundary: Absence from this audit is not proof that no private or unindexed analysis file exists.

consequence.orientation: retain 4-6 repeated changes and relative lineage-depth ensemble, but only the cross-study core-Nipponocirsium stem can currently be bounded for historical-environment analysis
consequence.phyllary_posture: retain exactly 3 changes and relative-depth envelope; historical trigger remains not_evaluable
consequence.stickiness: retain exactly 5 shallow-biased changes; range-event ages cannot be assigned to trait transitions

stop_rules: Do not infer calendar ages from published phylogeny graphics.
Do not scale Japan38 relative lineage depth by the approximately 2.4 Ma Japanese-radiation context.
Do not assign a published lineage split or dispersal date to a capitulum-trait transition unless the change-bearing branch is explicitly reconciled.
Do not turn failure to recover a public processed tree into evidence that no such tree exists privately.
next_external_resolution: A machine-readable dated tree/posterior from the original analyses, or a newly generated calibrated tree from primary sequence data under an explicitly justified dating model, would be required to calendar-bound additional repeated transitions. The latter would be a new analysis rather than recovery of a published processed tree.
